_hinweis: Buchgerüst HOS (scripts/authoring/buchgeruest.py aus buch/HOS.json). Form je Station: «szene» wird gemalt und automatisch geprüft, «struktur» zeichnet das Werkzeug aus den Elementen. Vorläufig von oben; Band ist ein Titel in eigenen Worten.

figuren.FIG-HOSEA: Hosea: a man of about thirty-five, dark curly hair, full dark beard, earnest gentle face; a deep indigo-blue robe with a plain undyed wool mantle over one shoulder, bare-headed.
figuren.FIG-GOMER: Gomer: a young woman of about twenty, long dark hair under a saffron-yellow veil, a dusty-rose ankle-length robe with long sleeves, modestly and fully dressed; dignified, never sensual or caricatured.
figuren.FIG-ORT-HAUS: A simple flat-roofed mud-brick house of an Israelite town of the 8th century BC with a low wooden door, drawn with a few lines.
figuren.FIG-JESREEL: Jezreel, Hosea's elder son: a boy of about eight with dark curly hair, a short ochre-yellow tunic, barefoot.
figuren.FIG-LO-AMMI: Lo-ammi, Hosea's younger son: a small child of about two with short dark hair in a light blue little tunic.
figuren.FIG-LO-RUHAMA: Lo-ruhamah, Hosea's daughter: a girl of about five with a dark braid, a long rose-red dress, barefoot.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-BRANDOPFERALTAR: An altar of burnt offering: a single square altar of rough unhewn stones with a fire burning on top and a thin column of grey smoke; no animal shown on it.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-GOETZENBILD: A small gold-brown statuette of a standing figure on a low stone pedestal; no specific deity, no recognisable religion.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-KRONE: A golden crown set with a few coloured stones.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-LILIE: A lily of the field: a single pink-red tulip-like flower on a slender green stem with two long leaves.
figuren.FIG-OBJ-SAMEN: A hand turned palm-down scattering a few seed grains, beside it a small green seedling sprouting from the soil.
figuren.FIG-ORT-AEGYPTENLAND: Egypt: the broad blue Nile flowing between narrow green banks with a few date palms, beyond them pale yellow desert sand and two pyramids on the horizon, drawn with a few lines.
figuren.FIG-ORT-HAEUSER: Three simple cube-shaped houses with flat roofs, each with its own door, standing apart side by side, no wall around them.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-BETEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: two hands folded in prayer, palms together, painted in warm skin tones.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-ERBARMEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: two open hands held out, a red heart resting in them.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-FEHLT: A grey dashed outline of an empty shape with a small empty circle crossed by a slash; grey, never red.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-FLIEHEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a small figure running away, on white paper.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-GERICHT: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a pair of bronze scales with two hanging pans.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-HEILEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a man laying his hand on the forehead of a sick man on a sleeping mat, who is sitting up and looking better. Ordinary people, not Jesus: short hair or a plain head cloth, plain earth-coloured robes, no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-HERZ: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a plain red heart, no rays.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-KLUG: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: an owl, on white paper.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-LEBEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a small green seedling with two leaves, with a golden infinity loop beside it.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-MORGEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a yellow sun rising over a calm sea, the sky pale pink and gold.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-NEIN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a bold red X.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-REGEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a soft grey cloud with many short blue strokes of rain falling from it.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-TAGE: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a row of small suns, on white paper.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-TAU: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a few green grass blades with clear round dewdrops on them, in pale morning colours, on white paper.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-UMKEHR: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a soft brown arrow that turns back in a wide arc.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-VERGEBEN: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a creditor tearing a clay debt tablet in two in front of a kneeling debtor who looks up relieved. Ordinary people, not Jesus: short hair or a plain head cloth, plain earth-coloured robes, no white robe with a red mantle.
figuren.FIG-ZEICHEN-WEG: A sign as a small watercolour vignette: a trail of small brown footprints leading forward.

bilder.note_de: Fünf Stationen ([[HOS.1.2-HOS.14.9]]): gemalt ist nur die Zeichenhandlung, mit der das Buch beginnt, Hosea nimmt Gomer zur Frau ([[HOS.1.2-HOS.1.3]]), bewusst zurückhaltend; die übrigen Stationen sind Strukturbilder der Prophetenrede: Kindernamen und ihre Umkehrung, Busse und Antwort, die Wende in Gottes Herz und der Schlussruf zur Umkehr. Die Bildsprache der Kapitel 4–14 ist nicht bebildert; Verse nach Navigationszählung (deutsch 2,1–2 = [[HOS.1.10-HOS.1.11]], 2,25 = [[HOS.2.23]], 14,2 = [[HOS.14.1]]).

HOS-B1.form_grund_de: Der Text erzählt hier eine Zeichenhandlung als Geschehen (Hosea geht und nimmt Gomer).
HOS-B1.bild_en: Northern Israel, 8th century BC, in front of a simple flat-roofed mud-brick house with a low wooden door. Hosea, a dark-bearded man of about thirty-five in a deep indigo-blue robe, stands on the LEFT and holds out his right hand; Gomer, a young woman with a saffron-yellow veil and a dusty-rose robe, fully and modestly dressed, steps out of the doorway on the RIGHT and lays her hand in his. Her eyes are lowered, her other hand holds the edge of her veil; his face is earnest and quiet, not joyful. Only the two of them, no other people, a bare beaten-earth yard. Restrained and calm. Medium shot, the upper third empty paper.

evidence.de: Er ging und nahm Gomer, die Tochter Diblajims.
Geh, nimm dir eine Frau der Hurerei, denn das Land ist von JHWH abgefallen.
Hand in Hand vor dem Haus ihres Vaters als Bild für «nahm sie»; wie die Heirat geschah, sagt der Text nicht.
Zurückhaltend gemalt: «Frau der Hurerei» wird nicht ausgemalt; ernstes Gesicht Hoseas als Hinweis auf den Auftrag als Zeichen.

Ich erbarme mich der Lo-Ruhama und sage zu Lo-Ammi: Du bist mein Volk.
Viele Tage ohne König und Opfer; danach kehren sie um und suchen JHWH.
